mystery(a,b){
 if (a < 0 or b < 0) return 0;

}

Let $S$ be the statement:

for i:=1 to N do V[i]:=V[i]+1

Which of the following perform(s) the same changes to $\textsf{V}$ as $\textsf{S}?$

questions.qtext:
Consider the following C code where main shows the intended use of the functions relating to struct foo.

struct foo {
 int x;
 int y;
 int * p;
};
struct foo* make_foo() {
 struct foo *foo = malloc(sizeof(struct foo ));
 foo->y = 2;
 foo->x = foo->y*2;
 foo->p = malloc(sizeof(int));
 *(foo->p) = 42;
 return foo;
}
void update_foo(struct foo *foo) {
 int num = *(foo->p);
 foo->p = malloc(sizeof(int));
 *(foo->p) = num + 1;
}
void free_foo(struct foo *foo) {
 free(foo);
 free(foo->p);
}
int main() {
 struct foo *f = make_foo();
 update_foo(f);
 free_foo(f);
}
